params.body:
Replaces #2, which conflicted with main after #3 (YubiKey signing over NFC). This is the same change, rebuilt on a fresh `origin/main` with everything #3 and #5 (typing on the voice screen) added kept. #2 can be closed.

The workbench screen now handles refusals, ending a word, and a session that ends in the middle of a touch. It reads Portal's new fields as optional, so it also runs against the Portal that is live now. The Portal side is abovebeyond-ai/portal#368 (branch `workbench/app-workbench-refusals`; #2's body wrongly said the branch names matched).

**A way out per refusal.** `PortalApi` raises `Refused(status, reason, message)` from Portal's `{"message", "refused"}`, and `Unreachable` when there is no answer at all. Both are `IOException`s, so `SignFlow`'s handling from #3 is unchanged. `api/WayOut.kt` maps each refusal to one action, shown under the sentence:

| refusal | offered |
|---|---|
| `ask_again`, `signature` | Touch again |
| `outside_working_set` | Admit for the rest of the day instead |
| `working_set_ended` | Look again |
| `no_passkey`, `key_unknown` | Open your keys in Portal |
| `key_not_yours`, 401 | Sign in again |
| `no_working_set` | Sign a working set on the YubiKey (opens #3's sign screen) |
| no answer, 5xx | Try again (the same action) |

A screen that fails to load gets a Retry action next to the pull-down.

**Ending without a key.** A project with a word in force shows "end now", and a standing working set shows "end the working set now". Each asks once in place before it posts to `/app/workbench/revoke` or `/app/workbench/working-set/end`.

**Kept across signing in.** If the session ends during a touch, the app keeps the duration and the selection. After the passkey sign-in, the workbench opens with the same projects ticked and says so. It does not repeat the touch on its own.

**Changed from #2 for #3.** In `App.kt`, the workbench place is `WorkbenchPlace` followed by #3's "Sign on the YubiKey" link, and #3's `Place.Sign` and `AppState.sign` stay as they were. The YubiKey way out is now an action instead of a pointer to the laptop. In `docs/protocol.md`, the YubiKey section now refers to `docs/yubikey.md` instead of sketching an NFC flow.

**docs/protocol.md** also documents what ending does not reach. A capability the hand already holds stands at the gateway until it expires. The doc sketches a revocation list the gateway could pull the way it pulls its policy log, which would be a change in control and Portal.

Tests: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assemblePreview` passes on main as of #5, 40 tests and 0 failures. That includes #3's signing tests and screenshots, `WayOutTest`, and the screenshot of a refusal with its way out.
params.title: Workbench: a way out of every refusal, ending a word, the touch kept across signing in (replaces #2)
